reason: I already keep my spending in a Google Sheet and it works for me, so I don't want a new app that asks me to change how I track things. The slip idea is clever, but I'm not paying for something I still have to set up on my phone before it's useful.
objection: The iPhone Shortcut setup looks complicated, even with a video. If I spend twenty minutes on it and the slips still come out wrong, I've wasted my evening and I'm back to typing.
would_change_my_mind: A setup that takes a couple of minutes with no fiddling, and a way to export to my own spreadsheet so I don't feel locked in.
